events.text:
I made no changes for this update and T-061 stays blocked.

- **Key no longer blocking (ripple ask):** already true. The key was saved in the live centre on 11 Oct, and `needs_from_owner` only asks for the mailbox.
- **Email only, WhatsApp off:** already the case. `createLaneCampaigns` in `cloud/src/lane.ts` only adds WhatsApp when a WhatsApp account is set, and none is. I checked this in the code, not by running anything.
- **Still blocked:** Adi needs to connect team@growthclub.org as a mailbox at https://app.usetantra.com (Email Accounts, Connect account). That's the same ask as on T-123. I took "still missing" from today's T-123 and T-234 logs. I couldn't check it myself because the live `/admin/api/lanes` endpoint needs an admin login and returned 401.
- **Ack:** R-74279083 is acknowledged.

No files changed, so there was nothing to commit.
